lines.say: It went viral: 100,000 people opened your app at once. So why didn't it go down?
lines.show: It went *viral:* 100,000 people opened your app at once. So why didn't it go [down?]

lines.say: One server would crash under that crowd. So you run copies of your app on ten servers.
lines.show: One server would [crash] under that crowd. So you run *copies* of your app on 10 servers.

lines.say: But who decides which server gets each request? A load balancer.
lines.show: But who *decides* which server gets each request? A *load balancer.*

lines.say: Like a store manager sending you to the shortest checkout line.
lines.show: Like a *store manager* sending you to the *shortest* checkout line.

lines.say: The simplest rule, round robin, just takes turns: one, two, three, back to one. A smarter rule, least connections, picks the server with the fewest open connections.
lines.show: The simplest rule, *round robin,* just takes turns: one, two, three, back to one. A smarter rule, *least connections,* picks the server with the fewest open connections.

lines.say: It also pings every server every few seconds. Any server that stops answering gets skipped.
lines.show: It also *pings* every server every few seconds. Any server that [stops answering] gets *skipped.*

lines.say: Need more power? Add servers behind it, and users keep the same address.
lines.show: Need more power? *Add servers* behind it, and users keep the *same address.*

lines.say: AWS, Engine X and Cloudflare do this for you.
lines.show: *AWS, NGINX* and *Cloudflare* do this for you.

lines.say: If AI writes your code, follow for the system design it leaves out.
lines.show: If AI writes your code, *follow* for the system design it leaves out.
